summary: UBOS Phase 0 backend + frontend verified. All 13 pytest cases pass (health, openapi, entity types CRUD + duplicate/invalid key + cascade delete, fields CRUD + duplicate + unknown type + reorder, records validation matrix — required/negative/dropdown/duplicate SKU — with per-entity_type record_number counter, tenant isolation across org-a/org-b, seed-demo idempotency). Frontend flows verified via Playwright: sidebar/health, Load demo data seeds Products+Machines, entity-type create with auto-slugify + delete, records list, dynamic record dialog rendering all 6 field types (text/number/switch/select/date/textarea), inline field errors ('is required', 'must be unique — value already exists', 'must be at least 0'), valid create/edit/delete, fields page with reorder+delete buttons and full 16-type Select for field type. No blocking bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — should be migrated to lifespan context manager in a future iteration (non-blocking).
GET /api/entity-types/{id}/fields and /records both return 404 when the entity type is soft-deleted (good UX for cascade); consumers should be aware.
Records list default sort is created_at desc — the top row depends on load timing; UI/tests should re-query the DOM after PATCH/POST to avoid stale reads.
record_counter is stored on entity_type doc and monotonically increments via $inc — never reused even after deletes. This is intentional and matches Phase-0 acceptance.
test_credentials: none (Phase 0 has no auth; X-Org-Id header defaults to demo-org)
seed_data_creation: POST /api/dev/seed-demo creates Products (6 fields, 3 records) and Machines (3 fields, 2 records) idempotently for org=demo-org. Idempotency verified — 2nd call creates 0 additional records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini enforces `-n 2 --dist loadscope` xdist. Because two test classes share the same demo-org keys, cross-worker races can occur — always run this file with `-n 0` (e.g. `pytest backend/tests/test_ubos_phase0.py -n 0`). Fixtures are module-scoped and self-cleaning. Frontend tests: sonner toasts can overlap top-right buttons — always click with force=True and wait for networkidle after route changes. Seeded record numbering: Products REC-000001..REC-000003, Machines REC-000001..REC-000002 (per-entity_type counters independent).
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found in this iteration.
